title: "Runtime and Ratings"
jupyter: python3
---

Do longer films get better ratings? @fig-runtime-rating plots runtime against ratings

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Runtime (minutes) against rating"

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("Rating (0 to 10)")
plt.show()
```

Mean rating by decade:

```{python}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
